description: Phase 8 page-level and end-to-end evaluation queries for the 7 ingested SAP Help pages

authorship.authored_by: AI coding assistant, after reading the ingested pages; not a human domain expert; no LLM generation at runtime
authorship.caveat: answerable queries are paraphrases of page facts written with the page text in view; they are not blind. The set is small (per-page n of 6-10) and every metric derived from it is a point estimate with wide uncertainty.
authorship.out_of_domain_origin: every 7th out_of_domain query (sorted by id) of data/evaluation/phase7F_ood_queries.json, first 8

preregistered.router: rank-1 of the card router, no similarity threshold (Phase 7F: min_cosine stays None)
preregistered.hit_definition: a retrieved chunk whose text contains (whitespace-normalised) any evidence quote of the query
preregistered.answer_correct_definition: status == answered AND at least one cited chunk contains an evidence quote AND the cited page is the gold page

queries.query: Which transaction do I use to monitor meter reading results by different selection criteria?
evidence: You can use this transaction to monitor meter reading results based on different selection criteria.

queries.query: If I start from a device, what can I display?
evidence: If you start by entering devices, you can display meter reading orders or meter reading results.

queries.query: Which business function lets me display meter reading results when I begin with portions or reading units?
evidence: If the business function Utilities, Quantity Determination ( ISU_QD_1 ) is active, you can also display meter reading results.

queries.query: Which transaction triggers automatic follow-on processing for meter reading orders?
evidence: trigger automatic follow-on processing for selected meter reading orders

queries.query: How can I see which meter reading documents were posted successfully after an IDoc upload?
evidence: display the successfully and unsuccessfully posted meter reading documents after uploading discrete meter reading data

queries.query: How do I get an overview of the devices in a reading unit?
evidence: You can use this transaction to get an overview of the devices of a meter reading unit.

queries.query: What must be activated before I can run quantity determination from the result lists?
evidence: you have activated the business function Utilities, Quantity Determination ( ISU_QD_1 )

queries.query: How do I jump to the detailed view of an object in the monitoring lists?
evidence: you can navigate to the detailed display of an object by choosing Edit > Select or by double clicking on the field in question

queries.query: Why does the monitoring table mark some entries with an asterisk?
evidence: At first the system displays a summarized list grouped by date

queries.query: What is the purpose of the device management component?
evidence: This component manages technical data, installations, meter readings, and the inspection of devices.

queries.query: A device in IS-U corresponds to which object in the standard system?
evidence: Name in IS-U: Device; From Component: Plant Maintenance (PM); Name in Standard System: Equipment

queries.query: What does the device number map to outside IS-U?
evidence: Name in IS-U: Device Number; From Component: Logistics Basic Data (LO-MD); Name in Standard System: Serial Number

queries.query: Where does a device number originate?
evidence: The device number is created in MM with the Goods Receipt function and transferred to the device.

queries.query: What makes a device unique and distinguishes it from other material with the same serial number?
evidence: The device is identified by a unique material and serial number combination

queries.query: At what point are equipment records generated?
evidence: Equipment records are created automatically during goods receipt

queries.query: Which purchasing component supplies requisitions and orders for device procurement?
evidence: Purchase Requisition and Purchase Order from Purchasing (MM-PUR)

queries.query: Which component takes care of billing in the device flow?
evidence: Billing is then carried out with the Sales and Distribution (SD) component.

queries.query: Where can I read more about the advanced metering infrastructure?
evidence: you can find more information under Advanced Metering Infrastructure

queries.query: Under what conditions should an installment plan be set up?
evidence: You create an installment plan when both of the following apply

queries.query: Which transaction code starts the creation of an installment plan?
evidence: choose Account > Installment Plan > Create (transaction FPR1 )

queries.query: Which indicator do I set to prioritize clearing of the original items when payments arrive?
evidence: you set the Clrg Priority indicator

queries.query: Which fields does the system take over from the original item into the plan?
evidence: the system copies the company code, contract, business area, and business place from the original item

queries.query: How can I avoid copying the company code and contract into the plan?
evidence: you can do this by defining event 3000 accordingly

queries.query: Is it possible to have the first installment computed as a share of the plan total?
evidence: The system can calculate the first installment as a percentage of the total amount of the installment plan.

queries.query: What effect does the Distribute indicator have?
evidence: If you set the Distribute indicator, the interest and charges are distributed over all of the due dates.

queries.query: Where can the leftover amount of a plan be placed?
evidence: In the Remaining Amount field, specify whether this remaining amount is to be included in the first or last installment, or in a new installment.

queries.query: What can I edit in the installment plan proposal?
evidence: An Installment Plan Proposal appears, in which you can make the following changes

queries.query: Which entries are mandatory when entering the plan parameters?
evidence: You must enter the installment interval and the interval type, as well as the installment plan category.

queries.query: What link does invoicing establish?
evidence: Invoicing creates the link to contract accounting and provides the basis for bill creation.

queries.query: What has to exist before invoicing can run?
evidence: Billing documents from the Contract Billing (IS-U-BI) component, or budget billing plans

queries.query: What is the outcome of invoicing with bill creation?
evidence: Invoicing with Bill Creation results in a print document and a contract accounting document.

queries.query: Which document is needed to print a bill?
evidence: To print the bill, you require the print document.

queries.query: How do I tell customers about the number and due dates of their budget billings?
evidence: you use either the Partial Bill Creation function or the Budget Billing Request function

queries.query: What do I use for bills that turn out to be wrong after they were updated in FI-CA?
evidence: you must process them using the Bill Reversal function

queries.query: Which function reverses billing documents that were already invoiced?
evidence: you can use the Full Reversal function

queries.query: When are postings made for a consumption bill that was outsorted?
evidence: Postings do not take place until the bill is released using the Outsorting function.

queries.query: What becomes of the bill once it has been created?
evidence: After the bill has been created, it is sent to the bill recipient.

queries.query: What does the contract account component enable?
evidence: This component enables you to create and manage contract account master data.

queries.query: May one business partner own several contract accounts?
evidence: You can assign more than one contract account to a given business partner.

queries.query: In utilities, which contracts are grouped in a single contract account?
evidence: one contract account contains all those contracts belonging to one business partner for which the same payment and dunning terms apply

queries.query: Can an individual utility contract sit in more than one contract account?
evidence: each individual contract is assigned to one contract account only

queries.query: How many business partners can a telecommunications contract account have?
evidence: a contract account can be assigned to one business partner only

queries.query: Can a business transaction automatically block a contract account?
evidence: a return can result in a processing lock being set

queries.query: Are modifications to contract account master data recorded?
evidence: The system logs changes to master data.

queries.query: How are contract accounts used for taxes in the public sector?
evidence: You set up the contract accounts of a business partner for the relevant taxes

queries.query: What data does billing use to determine the evaluation basis?
evidence: Billing uses meter reading results or load profiles to determine the evaluation basis for schema execution.

queries.query: What does the system do if a price changes in the middle of a billing period?
evidence: a price change causes the system to divide the total period into subperiods

queries.query: At which step are the rate calculations carried out?
evidence: All calculations required for rate creation are made during schema execution.

queries.query: Is it allowed for master data to change while a billing period is running?
evidence: All master and billing master data can change during a billing period.

queries.query: How is consumption handled when a billing period is split?
evidence: The system also divides the total consumption, which produces the corresponding partial amount.

queries.query: Which period categories can be handled by the billing procedures?
evidence: You can process all known period categories using different billing procedures.

queries.query: What does the move-in and move-out component let me do?
evidence: This component enables you to process a customer move-in or move-out.

queries.query: What happens to the customer's contract on a move-out?
evidence: In a move-out, you terminate the customer's contract.

queries.query: Which component produces welcome letters and move-out confirmations?
evidence: are created using the Print Workbench component

queries.query: Which activities can the system start by itself during a move-in or move-out?
evidence: You can have the system trigger a number of activities automatically.

queries.query: Which component allows me to monitor and configure the workflow processes?
evidence: The SAP Business Workflow component (BC-BMT-WFM) enables you to monitor and configure the workflow processes.

queries.query: What can I do about the business partner and contract account when a customer moves in?
evidence: you can create a business partner and contract account for the customer, or select existing ones

queries.query: What happens to an installation when a new customer moves in after a move-out?
evidence: If a new customer moves into the installation, the installation is allocated to this customer's contract.

queries.query: Can I adapt how the screen looks for move-in and move-out?
evidence: You can also configure the screen layout to suit your requirements.
